item.title: Fatal HPD Shooting: No Charges For Cops Who Shot Barricaded Man
item.description: Honolulu Prosecutor Steve Alm said officers did not know the gun that Eric Walsh pointed at them was a replica that didn't fire bullets.

item.title: LNG Is A Sensible Solution For Oahu’s Future Energy Needs
item.description: Let’s encourage and subsidize rooftop solar but also recognize that 69% of the island’s power comes from burning oil.

item.title: Mistaken ID Case At Hawaiʻi State Hospital May Cost State $200K
item.description: A man with a history of mental illness was held at the Oʻahu jail and Hawaiʻi State Hospital for nearly three years after police mistook him for a wanted felon.

item.title: Water Main Break Adds Up And Down Ride To Travel On Kamehameha Highway
item.description: There's no ETA for repairs to a buckled spot of road on Oʻahu's Windward side.

item.title: Hilo’s Beloved Banyan Drive Is In Ruins. Could A New Agency Save It?
item.description: Lawmakers want a hotel built at Hilo's airport to meet the housing needs of the Merrie Monarch festival while longer-term efforts to revitalize the once-thriving tourist district continue.

item.title: Failed $20 Bribe: 92-Year-Old Architect Sentenced In Honolulu Permitting Case
item.description: Kiyoshi Toi said he was giving the employee lunch money. The judge saw it as an attempt to influence him.
